Plan Your Jewellery Enquiry

What to Discuss Before You Order

A few details can make it easier to understand your options and receive a useful estimate.

Your Design or Requirement

Explain whether you need a custom piece, bridal jewellery, a daily-wear design, polishing or a repair. A reference photo can help communicate your preferred style.

Gold Karat and Weight

Ask which karat is being discussed and how the estimated gold weight affects the piece. You can also check the published gold rate for Sargodha.

Cost and Work Details

Before confirming, ask for the gold value, making or repair charges, design details and any other applicable costs to be explained clearly.

Timing and Collection

For a custom order or repair, confirm the expected completion time and collection arrangements before the work is agreed.
